best: Power paths are drawn as real wired left-to-right paths (3V3 buck, four-switch stage with input/output cap banks, 5 V buck, back-to-back protection FETs with fuse) under clear block titles and notes.
worst: Overlapping text around the gauge and charger ICs: C105/R105, TH101/R113/TH104 values and refs collide on the BQ40Z50, R445/R446 gate resistors and HG2 label collide on the BQ25756, pin-number piles at U401/U405 ground pins, J120/J116 texts run together.

Many parts float alone tied only by labels (D101, D401 TVS, Q409, Q103, EEPROM, EN_5V pull-down, pull-up row detached from its lines, CELL_1N label stubs everywhere), so checking against datasheets needs net-name searching.
Unbalanced page use: MCU and 3V3 sheets are half empty, USB sheets have a large empty lower-left/bottom while the charger block is dense with long wrap-around wires and small text.
